```{r}
# Create descriptive table of participant characteristics

participants <- data_imp %>%
  distinct(CASE, Age, Gender, Pro_Sante) %>%
  mutate(
    Gender = case_when(
      Gender == "F" ~ "Female",
      Gender == "M" ~ "Male",
      TRUE ~ as.character(Gender)
    ),
    Pro_Sante = case_when(
      Pro_Sante == 1 ~ "Healthcare professional",
      Pro_Sante == 2 ~ "Mental health professional",
      Pro_Sante == 3 ~ "Other professions",
      TRUE ~ as.character(Pro_Sante)
    )
  )

n_participants <- nrow(participants)
mean_age <- mean(participants$Age, na.rm = TRUE)
sd_age <- sd(participants$Age, na.rm = TRUE)

gender_tab <- participants %>%
  count(Gender) %>%
  mutate(
    Percent = round(100 * n / sum(n), 1),
    Value = paste0(n, " (", Percent, "%)")
  )

prosante_tab <- participants %>%
  count(Pro_Sante) %>%
  mutate(
    Percent = round(100 * n / sum(n), 1),
    Value = paste0(n, " (", Percent, "%)")
  )

get_value <- function(tab, group_col, group_value) {
  out <- tab$Value[match(group_value, tab[[group_col]])]
  ifelse(is.na(out), "0 (0.0%)", out)
}

desc_table <- tibble(
  `Observer participants, N` = n_participants,
  `Age, years, M (SD)` = paste0(round(mean_age, 2), " (", round(sd_age, 2), ")"),
  `Female, n (%)` = get_value(gender_tab, "Gender", "Female"),
  `Male, n (%)` = get_value(gender_tab, "Gender", "Male"),
  `Healthcare professional, n (%)` = get_value(prosante_tab, "Pro_Sante", "Healthcare professional"),
  `Mental health professional, n (%)` = get_value(prosante_tab, "Pro_Sante", "Mental health professional"),
  `Other professions, n (%)` = get_value(prosante_tab, "Pro_Sante", "Other professions")
)

tab1 <- nice_table(
  desc_table,
  title = c("Table 1", "Participant characteristics"),
  note = c("Percentages are based on the total number of participants.")
)

tab1
```

```{r}
check_model_basic <- function(model) {
  par(mfrow = c(1, 2))
  qqnorm(resid(model))
  qqline(resid(model))
  plot(fitted(model), resid(model))
  abline(h = 0, lty = 2)
  print(summary(model))
  print(VarCorr(model))
}
```

```{r}
plot_emm_p <- function(model, score_name, y_lab = "Estimated marginal mean") {
  
  # Estimated marginal means
  emm <- as.data.frame(emmeans(model, ~ Type))
  
  # Pairwise comparison from the model
  contrast_res <- as.data.frame(summary(pairs(emmeans(model, ~ Type))))
  p_val <- contrast_res$p.value[1]
  
  # Significance label
  p_label <- dplyr::case_when(
    p_val <= .001 ~ "***",
    p_val <= .01  ~ "**",
    p_val <= .05  ~ "*",
    TRUE ~ "ns"
  )
  
  # Position for annotation
  y_max <- max(emm$upper.CL)
  y_line <- y_max + 0.06 * y_max
  y_text <- y_max + 0.10 * y_max
  
  ggplot(emm, aes(x = Type, y = emmean, fill = Type)) +
    geom_col(width = 0.6, color = "black", alpha = 0.9) +
    geom_errorbar(
      aes(ymin = lower.CL, ymax = upper.CL),
      width = 0.15,
      linewidth = 0.6
    ) +
    annotate("segment", x = 1, xend = 2, y = y_line, yend = y_line, linewidth = 0.6) +
    annotate("segment", x = 1, xend = 1, y = y_line, yend = y_line - 0.03 * y_max, linewidth = 0.6) +
    annotate("segment", x = 2, xend = 2, y = y_line, yend = y_line - 0.03 * y_max, linewidth = 0.6) +
    annotate("text", x = 1.5, y = y_text, label = p_label, size = 5) +
    scale_fill_manual(values = c("Healthy" = "orange", "Patient" = "steelblue")) +
    labs(
      title = score_name,
      x = "Target type",
      y = y_lab
    ) +
    coord_cartesian(ylim = c(min(emm$lower.CL) * 0.95, y_max + 0.18 * y_max)) +
    theme_classic(base_size = 12) +
    theme(
      legend.position = "none",
      plot.title = element_text(hjust = 0.5, face = "bold"),
      axis.title.x = element_text(face = "bold"),
      axis.title.y = element_text(face = "bold"),
      axis.text = element_text(color = "black")
    )
}
```


```{r}
# =========================================================
# MIXED-EFFECTS MODELS FOR TOTAL SCORES
# =========================================================

# Packages
library(readr)
library(dplyr)
library(tidyr)
library(ggplot2)
library(lme4)
library(lmerTest)
library(emmeans)
library(car)
library(performance)
library(partR2)
library(tibble)
library(purrr)

# ---------------------------------------------------------
# 1. LOAD DATA
# ---------------------------------------------------------

data_imp <- read_csv("../data/data_imp.csv", show_col_types = FALSE)

# ---------------------------------------------------------
# 2. PREPARE VARIABLES AND BUILD TOTAL SCORES
# ---------------------------------------------------------

data_imp <- prepare_questionnaire_scores(data_imp)

# ---------------------------------------------------------
# 3. DESCRIPTIVE STATISTICS
# ---------------------------------------------------------

descriptive_totals <- data_imp %>%
  group_by(Type) %>%
  summarise(
    FirstImpression_Mean = mean(FirstImpression_total, na.rm = TRUE),
    FirstImpression_SD = sd(FirstImpression_total, na.rm = TRUE),
    InteractionIntent_Mean = mean(InteractionIntent_total, na.rm = TRUE),
    InteractionIntent_SD = sd(InteractionIntent_total, na.rm = TRUE),
    Global_Mean = mean(Global_total, na.rm = TRUE),
    Global_SD = sd(Global_total, na.rm = TRUE),
    N = n(),
    .groups = "drop"
  )

print(descriptive_totals)

# ---------------------------------------------------------
# 4. FIT MODELS
# ---------------------------------------------------------

options(contrasts = c("contr.sum", "contr.poly"))

model_fi <- lmer(
  FirstImpression_total ~ Type + num_video + (1 | CASE) + (1 | video_id),
  data = data_imp,
  REML = FALSE
)

model_ii <- lmer(
  InteractionIntent_total ~ Type + num_video + (1 | CASE) + (1 | video_id),
  data = data_imp,
  REML = FALSE
)

model_global <- lmer(
  Global_total ~ Type + num_video + (1 | CASE) + (1 | video_id),
  data = data_imp,
  REML = FALSE
)

# ---------------------------------------------------------
# 5. FUNCTION TO EXTRACT PUBLICATION-READY RESULTS
# ---------------------------------------------------------

extract_model_results <- function(model, model_name, data) {
  
  # Fixed effects table
  fixed_tab <- coef(summary(model)) %>%
    as.data.frame() %>%
    tibble::rownames_to_column("Predictor") %>%
    rename(
      SE = `Std. Error`,
      t = `t value`,
      p = `Pr(>|t|)`
    ) %>%
    mutate(Model = model_name) %>%
    select(Model, Predictor, Estimate, SE, df, t, p)
  
  # Type III ANOVA
  anova_tab <- car::Anova(model, type = 3) %>%
    as.data.frame() %>%
    tibble::rownames_to_column("Predictor") %>%
    mutate(Model = model_name) %>%
    select(Model, Predictor, everything())
  
  # Random effects table
  vc <- as.data.frame(VarCorr(model)) %>%
    transmute(
      Model = model_name,
      Group = grp,
      Term = var1,
      Variance = vcov,
      SD = sdcor
    )
  
  # R2
  r2_vals <- performance::r2(model)
  r2_tab <- tibble(
    Model = model_name,
    Marginal_R2 = r2_vals$R2_marginal,
    Conditional_R2 = r2_vals$R2_conditional
  )
  
  # Part R2
  pr2 <- partR2(
    model,
    partvars = c("Type", "num_video"),
    data = data
  )
  
  pr2_tab <- as.data.frame(pr2$R2) %>%
    rename(
      Predictor = term,
      Part_R2 = estimate
    ) %>%
    mutate(Model = model_name) %>%
    select(Model, Predictor, Part_R2, CI_lower, CI_upper)
  
  # EMMs
  emm <- emmeans(model, ~ Type)
  emm_tab <- as.data.frame(summary(emm)) %>%
    mutate(Model = model_name) %>%
    rename(
      Group = Type,
      Estimated_Mean = emmean,
      Lower_95CI = lower.CL,
      Upper_95CI = upper.CL
    ) %>%
    select(Model, Group, Estimated_Mean, SE, df, Lower_95CI, Upper_95CI)
  
  # Pairwise comparison
  contrast_tab <- as.data.frame(summary(pairs(emm))) %>%
    mutate(Model = model_name) %>%
    rename(
      Contrast = contrast,
      Estimate = estimate,
      t = t.ratio,
      p = p.value
    ) %>%
    select(Model, Contrast, Estimate, SE, df, t, p)
  
  list(
    fixed = fixed_tab,
    anova = anova_tab,
    random = vc,
    r2 = r2_tab,
    part_r2 = pr2_tab,
    emmeans = emm_tab,
    contrasts = contrast_tab
  )
}
# ---------------------------------------------------------
# 6. EXTRACT RESULTS FOR ALL MODELS
# ---------------------------------------------------------

res_fi <- extract_model_results(model_fi, "First impression total", data_imp)
res_ii <- extract_model_results(model_ii, "Interaction intention total", data_imp)
res_global <- extract_model_results(model_global, "Global total", data_imp)

# ---------------------------------------------------------
# 7. COMBINE TABLES
# ---------------------------------------------------------

fixed_results <- bind_rows(res_fi$fixed, res_ii$fixed, res_global$fixed)
anova_results <- bind_rows(res_fi$anova, res_ii$anova, res_global$anova)
random_results <- bind_rows(res_fi$random, res_ii$random, res_global$random)
r2_results <- bind_rows(res_fi$r2, res_ii$r2, res_global$r2)
part_r2_results <- bind_rows(res_fi$part_r2, res_ii$part_r2, res_global$part_r2)
emmeans_results <- bind_rows(res_fi$emmeans, res_ii$emmeans, res_global$emmeans)
contrast_results <- bind_rows(res_fi$contrasts, res_ii$contrasts, res_global$contrasts)

print(fixed_results)
print(anova_results)
print(random_results)
print(r2_results)
print(part_r2_results)
print(emmeans_results)
print(contrast_results)

# ---------------------------------------------------------
# 8. OPTIONAL: CLEAN SUMMARY TABLE FOR PUBLICATION
# ---------------------------------------------------------

publication_table <- fixed_results %>%
  filter(Predictor %in% c("Type1", "num_video")) %>%
  left_join(
    part_r2_results %>% select(Model, Predictor, Part_R2),
    by = c("Model", "Predictor")
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    p = ifelse(p < .001, "< .001", sprintf("%.3f", p)),
    Estimate = round(Estimate, 2),
    SE = round(SE, 2),
    df = round(df, 2),
    t = round(t, 2),
    Part_R2 = round(Part_R2, 4)
  )

print(publication_table)

# ---------------------------------------------------------
# 9. FUNCTION TO PLOT MODEL-BASED GROUP DIFFERENCES
# ---------------------------------------------------------

plot_model_results <- function(model, model_name, y_label, data) {
  
  emm_obj <- emmeans(model, ~ Type)
  emm <- as.data.frame(summary(emm_obj))
  
  contrast_tab <- as.data.frame(summary(pairs(emm_obj)))
  p_val <- contrast_tab$p.value[1]
  diff_estimate <- abs(contrast_tab$estimate[1])
  
  pr2 <- partR2(
    model,
    partvars = c("Type", "num_video"),
    data = data
  )
  
  pr2_tab <- as.data.frame(pr2$R2)
  type_r2 <- pr2_tab$R2[pr2_tab$Predictor == "Type"]
  
  p_label <- ifelse(p_val < .001, "p < .001", paste0("p = ", sprintf("%.3f", p_val)))
  diff_label <- paste0("\u0394 = ", sprintf("%.2f", diff_estimate))
  r2_label <- paste0("part R² = ", sprintf("%.3f", type_r2))
  
  top_label <- paste(p_label, diff_label, r2_label, sep = "\n")
  
  y_max <- max(emm$upper.CL, na.rm = TRUE)
  y_min <- min(emm$lower.CL, na.rm = TRUE)
  y_range <- y_max - y_min
  
  y_line <- y_max + 0.08 * y_range
  y_text <- y_max + 0.18 * y_range
  y_upper <- y_max + 0.30 * y_range
  
  ggplot(emm, aes(x = Type, y = emmean, fill = Type)) +
    geom_col(width = 0.6, color = "black", alpha = 0.9) +
    geom_errorbar(
      aes(ymin = lower.CL, ymax = upper.CL),
      width = 0.15,
      linewidth = 0.6
    ) +
    annotate("segment", x = 1, xend = 2, y = y_line, yend = y_line, linewidth = 0.6) +
    annotate("segment", x = 1, xend = 1, y = y_line, yend = y_line - 0.04 * y_range, linewidth = 0.6) +
    annotate("segment", x = 2, xend = 2, y = y_line, yend = y_line - 0.04 * y_range, linewidth = 0.6) +
    annotate("text", x = 1.5, y = y_text, label = top_label, size = 4.2) +
    scale_fill_manual(values = c("Healthy" = "orange", "Patient" = "steelblue")) +
    labs(
      title = model_name,
      x = "Target type",
      y = y_label
    ) +
    coord_cartesian(ylim = c(y_min - 0.05 * y_range, y_upper)) +
    theme_classic(base_size = 12) +
    theme(
      legend.position = "none",
      plot.title = element_text(hjust = 0.5, face = "bold"),
      axis.title.x = element_text(face = "bold"),
      axis.title.y = element_text(face = "bold"),
      axis.text = element_text(color = "black")
    )
}

# ---------------------------------------------------------
# 10. CREATE PLOTS
# ---------------------------------------------------------

plot_fi <- plot_model_results(
  model_fi,
  model_name = "First impression total",
  y_label = "Estimated marginal mean",
  data = data_imp
)

plot_ii <- plot_model_results(
  model_ii,
  model_name = "Interaction intention total",
  y_label = "Estimated marginal mean",
  data = data_imp
)

plot_global <- plot_model_results(
  model_global,
  model_name = "Global total",
  y_label = "Estimated marginal mean",
  data = data_imp
)

plot_fi
plot_ii
plot_global

```

```{r}
# =========================================================
# ITEM-LEVEL MIXED-EFFECTS MODELS
# =========================================================

library(dplyr)
library(tidyr)
library(lme4)
library(lmerTest)
library(car)
library(emmeans)
library(partR2)
library(purrr)
library(tibble)
library(ggplot2)
library(readr)

# ---------------------------------------------------------
# 1. Define item labels
# ---------------------------------------------------------

item_labels <- c(
  Sympathique = "Sympathetic",
  Bizarre_inversed = "Awkward (reversed)",
  Intelligente = "Intelligent",
  Appreciable = "Likeable",
  Confiance = "Trustworthy",
  Dominante = "Dominant",
  Conversation = "Would chat",
  Temps = "Spend time",
  Voisin = "As neighbor",
  Assis = "Sit together"
)

items <- names(item_labels)

# ---------------------------------------------------------
# 2. Function to fit one item-level model and extract results
# ---------------------------------------------------------

extract_item_model <- function(item, data) {
  
  formula <- as.formula(
    paste0(item, " ~ Type + num_video + (1 | CASE) + (1 | video_id)")
  )
  
  model <- lmer(formula, data = data, REML = FALSE)
  
  # Fixed effects
  fixed_tab <- coef(summary(model)) %>%
    as.data.frame() %>%
    tibble::rownames_to_column("Predictor") %>%
    rename(
      SE = `Std. Error`,
      t = `t value`,
      p = `Pr(>|t|)`
    ) %>%
    mutate(
      Item = item,
      Item_label = item_labels[[item]]
    ) %>%
    select(Item, Item_label, Predictor, Estimate, SE, df, t, p)
  
  # Type III ANOVA
  anova_tab <- car::Anova(model, type = 3) %>%
    as.data.frame() %>%
    tibble::rownames_to_column("Predictor") %>%
    mutate(
      Item = item,
      Item_label = item_labels[[item]]
    ) %>%
    select(Item, Item_label, Predictor, everything())
  
  # part R²
  pr2 <- partR2(
    model,
    partvars = c("Type", "num_video"),
    data = data
  )
  
  pr2_tab <- as.data.frame(pr2$R2) %>%
    rename(
      Predictor = term,
      Part_R2 = estimate
    ) %>%
    mutate(
      Item = item,
      Item_label = item_labels[[item]]
    ) %>%
    select(Item, Item_label, Predictor, Part_R2, CI_lower, CI_upper)
  
  # Estimated marginal means
  emm <- emmeans(model, ~ Type)
  emm_tab <- as.data.frame(summary(emm)) %>%
    mutate(
      Item = item,
      Item_label = item_labels[[item]]
    ) %>%
    rename(
      Group = Type,
      Estimated_Mean = emmean,
      Lower_95CI = lower.CL,
      Upper_95CI = upper.CL
    ) %>%
    select(Item, Item_label, Group, Estimated_Mean, SE, df, Lower_95CI, Upper_95CI)
  
  # Pairwise contrast
  contrast_tab <- as.data.frame(summary(pairs(emm))) %>%
    mutate(
      Item = item,
      Item_label = item_labels[[item]]
    ) %>%
    rename(
      Contrast = contrast,
      t = t.ratio,
      p = p.value
    ) %>%
    select(Item, Item_label, Contrast, estimate, SE, df, t, p)
  
  list(
    model = model,
    fixed = fixed_tab,
    anova = anova_tab,
    part_r2 = pr2_tab,
    emmeans = emm_tab,
    contrast = contrast_tab
  )
}

# ---------------------------------------------------------
# 3. Run all item-level models
# ---------------------------------------------------------

item_results_list <- map(items, ~ extract_item_model(.x, data_imp))
names(item_results_list) <- items

# ---------------------------------------------------------
# 4. Combine outputs
# ---------------------------------------------------------

item_fixed_results <- bind_rows(map(item_results_list, "fixed"))
item_anova_results <- bind_rows(map(item_results_list, "anova"))
item_part_r2_results <- bind_rows(map(item_results_list, "part_r2"))
item_emmeans_results <- bind_rows(map(item_results_list, "emmeans"))
item_contrast_results <- bind_rows(map(item_results_list, "contrast"))

# ---------------------------------------------------------
# 5. Build publication-ready item table
# ---------------------------------------------------------

item_publication_table <- item_fixed_results %>%
  filter(Predictor %in% c("Type1", "num_video")) %>%
  left_join(
    item_part_r2_results %>%
      filter(Predictor %in% c("Type", "num_video")) %>%
      mutate(Predictor = ifelse(Predictor == "Type", "Type1", Predictor)) %>%
      select(Item, Predictor, Part_R2),
    by = c("Item", "Predictor")
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    Predictor = case_when(
      Predictor == "Type1" ~ "Target type",
      Predictor == "num_video" ~ "Presentation order",
      TRUE ~ Predictor
    )
  )

# Adjust p-values only for the main effect of target type across the 10 items
item_publication_table <- item_publication_table %>%
  group_by(Predictor) %>%
  mutate(
    p_adjusted = ifelse(
      Predictor == "Target type",
      p.adjust(p, method = "holm"),
      NA_real_
    )
  ) %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  mutate(
    Estimate = round(Estimate, 2),
    SE = round(SE, 2),
    df = round(df, 2),
    t = round(t, 2),
    Part_R2 = round(Part_R2, 4),
    p_raw = ifelse(p < .001, "< .001", sprintf("%.3f", p)),
    p_adjusted = case_when(
      is.na(p_adjusted) ~ NA_character_,
      p_adjusted < .001 ~ "< .001",
      TRUE ~ sprintf("%.3f", p_adjusted)
    )
  ) %>%
  select(
    Item_label, Predictor, Estimate, SE, df, t, p_raw, p_adjusted, Part_R2
  )

print(item_publication_table)

# ---------------------------------------------------------
# 6. Table focused only on the main effect of target type
# ---------------------------------------------------------

item_type_table <- item_publication_table %>%
  filter(Predictor == "Target type") %>%
  arrange(desc(Part_R2))

print(item_type_table)

item_emm_plot_data <- item_emmeans_results %>%
  mutate(
    Item_label = factor(Item_label, levels = item_labels)
  )

item_emm_plot <- ggplot(
  item_emm_plot_data,
  aes(x = Item_label, y = Estimated_Mean, fill = Group)
) +
  geom_col(position = position_dodge(width = 0.75), width = 0.65, color = "black") +
  geom_errorbar(
    aes(ymin = Lower_95CI, ymax = Upper_95CI),
    position = position_dodge(width = 0.75),
    width = 0.2
  ) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = c("Healthy" = "orange", "Patient" = "steelblue")) +
  theme_classic(base_size = 12) +
  theme(
    axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1),
    legend.position = "top"
  ) +
  labs(
    title = "Model-estimated means for each item by target type",
    x = "Item",
    y = "Estimated marginal mean",
    fill = "Target type"
  )

item_emm_plot
```
